_comment: Phase 4 additions to the existing Sepolia deployment. The executor, policy registry, ENS identity verifier and mock target from Phase 3 are REUSED UNCHANGED — their interfaces were unaffected by the CRE integration, which is the purpose of the IContextLockAuthorizationRegistry seam.

authorizationWriter.note: The EOA can no longer mint authorizations directly; CRE-007 proves this on-chain.

creForwarder.note: In a live deployment this is the Chainlink forwarder that has already verified DON consensus signatures. No live DON has written to this consumer. See reports/phase-04/blockers/BLK-001. The address is settable via setForwarder so the real forwarder can replace it without redeploying the executor or registry.
